rationale: Exists to be the TARGET of `import-resolution.dart`'s relative and bare imports, so the identity claim has both ends in one run: this file's library node publishes its project-relative path, and the importer's edge names that same string. Without a real sibling, the pair could only pin the SHAPE of the importer's target and not that anything answers to it — the difference between 'an edge names a path' and 'the path resolves', which is the whole question this round is about. `import-identity-pairing.ts` asserts the two ends against each other.

expectRelationships.note: 2026-10-08: the member's PUBLISHED spelling (`Owner.member`), not its bare name
